verdict.rationale: The official GitHub README documents a package-manager install (`brew install cactus-compute/cactus/cactus`, then `cactus run`), so developers do not need to compile from source. The run-locally docs list supported platforms (macOS/Linux on Arm and x86, Windows x64/Arm64) with only Python 3.9+ required, which suggests a prebuilt Python package, but they do not name it explicitly. Missing for 10: explicit prebuilt packages for Windows and the language bindings (pip, npm, Swift/Kotlin/Flutter registries), downloadable release binaries, and independent hands-on corroboration of the install path.
